title: Winspace G5 | Sram Rival

takeaways.text: Winspace claims 55 mm front and 50 mm rear; the dealer says a local customer fitted 2.25 in front and 2.10 in rear Schwalbe Thunder Burts (reported, not shown).
The G5 needs an external-bearing T47 bottom bracket, not an internal one; complete bikes ship with 40 mm of steerer spacers, stock 40 mm Michelin tires and a 2× option via the front-derailleur mount.
FIDLOCK down-tube storage with a bag, two under-down-tube bolts for a tool can, and a new aero seatpost with height markings.

disclosure: Published by a UK retailer that sells the bike and links its product page; YouTube flags the video as including paid promotion.
summary: Retailer walk-around of a complete G5 with SRAM Rival: frame details, storage, cockpit and build. Retailer material, not an independent review.
